calculation_handling.description: Under a federally regulated flight path the permitted height is the lower of this By-law's maximum and the federal maximum. This arm is the By-law's own maximum, which is keyed elsewhere.
Under a federally regulated flight path the permitted height is the lower of this By-law's maximum and the Government of Canada's maximum.
calculation_handling.gaps: Federal flight-path height limits are not held in our lot data.

units.disclosure: If the lot is under a flight path regulated by the Government of Canada, the federal height limit may be lower than the By-law's. We do not hold flight-path limits, so this cap is not applied.

5.10.40.10(1).explanation: If a lot is under a flight path regulated by the Government of Canada, the maximum building height is the lower of this By-law's maximum and the federal limit. We do not hold flight-path limits, so the federal cap is not applied.
